verdict.rationale: Apify explicitly states it works with Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, and Scrapy (in addition to its own Crawlee library), and provides SDKs/toolkits, CLI, and migration guides for building Actors around these frameworks. Missing for 10: no hands-on independent tutorial confirming each specific library integration in depth, and no code examples for Selenium/Scrapy specifically in the pack.
